namingNotes: Keep the brand (Hatch & Dash) stable and put the searchable words in the listing title after it. Rotate the bracketed tag with each update ([NEW BIOME], [🐉 DRAGON], [EVENT]) because Roblox re-surfaces games whose titles change. Test two listing titles for a week each at soft launch and keep the one with the higher click-through from search and recommendations. Avoid 'Escape Animals Obby' and 'Obby but Animals Chase You': the first is indistinguishable from a dozen animal escape obbies and the second is near-identical to an existing chase obby.
